tool.name: ccnv predict
tool.description: Normalize, segment, and call germline or prenatal copy-number variations
tool.command: CCNV_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && #if $sample.is_of_type("cram"): ln -s '$sample' sample.cram && #if $sample.metadata.cram_index and str($sample.metadata.cram_index) != 'None': ln -s '$sample.metadata.cram_index' sample.cram.crai && #else: CCNV_THREADS=1 && #end if #set $sample_input = "sample.cram" #elif $sample.is_of_type("bam"): ln -s '$sample' sample.bam && #if $sample.metadata.bam_index and str($sample.metadata.bam_index) != 'None': ln -s '$sample.metadata.bam_index' sample.bam.bai && #else: CCNV_THREADS=1 && #end if #set $sample_input = "sample.bam" #else: ln -s '$sample' sample.ccnv && #set $sample_input = "sample.ccnv" #end if ln -s '$reference' reference.ccnv && @STAGE_OPTIONAL_FASTA@ @STAGE_COVARIATE_TRACKS@ #if $deliverables.plot and $deliverables.cytobands: if gzip -t '$deliverables.cytobands' 2>/dev/null; then ln -s '$deliverables.cytobands' cytobands.bed.gz && CYTOBANDS_PATH=cytobands.bed.gz; else ln -s '$deliverables.cytobands' cytobands.bed && CYTOBANDS_PATH=cytobands.bed; fi && #end if ccnv predict '$sample_input' reference.ccnv --prefix out_pred --mode '$mode_cond.mode' #if $mode_cond.mode == "prenatal": $mode_cond.twins #else: --sex '$mode_cond.sex' #end if --penalty '$calling.penalty' --z-threshold '$calling.z_threshold' #if str($calling.ratio_threshold) not in ("", "None"): --ratio-threshold '$calling.ratio_threshold' #end if --min-reference-bins '$calling.min_reference_bins' --mask-repeats '$calling.mask_repeats' --max-blacklist-gap '$calling.max_blacklist_gap' $deliverables.plot #if $deliverables.plot and $deliverables.cytobands: --cytobands "\$CYTOBANDS_PATH" #end if $deliverables.vcf $deliverables.bins_vcf @FASTA_ARG@ @COVARIATE_ARGS@ --threads "\$CCNV_THREADS" --loglevel '$loglevel' && gzip -dc out_pred_bins.bed.gz > out_pred_bins.bed && gzip -dc out_pred_segments.bed.gz > out_pred_segments.bed && gzip -dc out_pred_calls.bed.gz > out_pred_calls.bed

param.name: sample
param.label: Sample input (.ccnv, BAM, or CRAM)
param.help: Sample Parquet from ccnv extract, or a BAM/CRAM alignment streamed directly on the reference grid.

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference model (.ccnv)
param.help: Reference Parquet built by ccnv reference matching the selected analysis mode.

param.label: Sex branch selection
param.help: Leave 'autosomal' to infer sample sex automatically when sex branches exist.

param.label: Known twin pregnancy
param.help: Force twin pregnancy modeling; leave unchecked for automatic singleton/twin stoichiometry evaluation.

param.label: Breakpoint penalty multiplier (gamma)
param.help: Multiplier on calibrated mBIC segmentation penalty.

param.label: Absolute segment Z-score cutoff
param.help: Minimum |Z| threshold for calling gains and losses.

param.label: Absolute log2-ratio cutoff (optional)
param.help: When set, overrides --z-threshold with an absolute log2-ratio threshold.

param.label: Maximum masked gap (bp)
param.help: Contig gaps exceeding this span split segments into separate euchromatic arm blocks.

param.label: Custom cytoband track (optional)
param.help: UCSC cytoband BED/TSV (plain or gzipped), overriding bundled GRCh38 cytobands when plotting.

param.label: Write VCFv4.2 segment and call outputs
Write per-bin VCFv4.2 output (requires VCF output)

tool.help:
**What it does**
``ccnv predict`` normalizes a test sample (``.ccnv``, BAM, or CRAM) against a reference model via robust Huber PCA projection and off-chromosome Prototype Graph medians, partitions chromosomes across euchromatic arm blocks using calibrated PELT segmentation, scores intervals with dyadic BLUE precision Z-scores, and calls discrete copy-number states (``CN in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4+}``).
In ``prenatal`` mode, it additionally computes fused multi-modal fetal fraction (``FFY``, ``FFA``, ``FFX``, ``FF_size``), 4D sex-chromosome aneuploidy classification, twin stoichiometry (``FF``, ``FM``, ``MM``), male-fetus 5 kb ``chrY`` MSY normalization, segment discordance checks, and 5-state biological origin classification.
**Outputs**
- **Bins / Segments / Calls BED**: Decompressed 0-based half-open BED tables for downstream Galaxy workflows. - **Segments / Calls / Bins VCF**: Bgzipped VCFv4.2 deliverables when ``--vcf`` (and optionally ``--bins-vcf``) is enabled. - **Prediction QC JSON**: Sample QC, fragmentomics summary, and prenatal metrics. - **Genome Plot HTML**: Interactive Plotly WebGL CNV viewer with UCSC cytoband ideogram track.
